blocks.name: Engineering Academic Block

blocks.description: A standalone academic block for Master of Business Administration. Home to the prestigious Belaku (ಬೆಳಕು) primary college auditorium, the Centre for Future Skills (Ethnotech Academy), Executive Board Room 2, faculty chambers, and smart lecture suites.

appHelp.answer: The Colleges & Blocks view is the home screen of MITM Navigo. Tap any academic block (Engineering, MBA, MCA, BCA, or Pharmacy) to explore that department's rooms and laboratories.
The Department Hub organizes the campus by academic specialization: CSE & AI, MBA, ISE, ECE, Mechanical & Civil, and BCA/Pharmacy. It features direct 1-tap room launchers.
Popular Hotspots highlights major campus destinations such as Belaku Auditorium, Centre for Future Skills, MCA Lab 1, and Room 114 for instant 1-tap walkthrough launching.

Every room has a step-by-step visual photo walkthrough from campus staircases (Point A, Point B, Point C). Use the Auto-Walk button to tour automatically, or step forward/back with arrow buttons. You can also share the exact room on WhatsApp!
